hours: Normal Trail hours Weekends & Holidays 9am – 4:30pm & non-holiday Mon-Fri 10am- 4:30pm.

notes.text: Thanks for a great season! Our first ski day was November 30, last ski day was April 1. Total of 116 ski days, 103″ snow.

Season passes for the 2026-27 winter season are on sale now and can be used for the remainder of the 2025-26 winter season. Download form here to mail with your check. For best pricing, purchase by August 1. .

Ski Shop is open by appointment – please call ahead. For seasonal rental equipment return, if we are not here you can drop off the equipment int he wax room (rightmost door) and call or email to arrange the refund of your deposit.
Fall lodging open thru October 17. Winter lodging season opens November 25.
Visit us on Facebook and Instragram for recent photos.
